title.narrative: Financial support to the police and civilian components of the African Union Transition Mission in Somalia (ATMIS) 2

description.narrative: The action provides financial support from the African Peace Facility (APF) to the African Union Transition Mission in Somalia (ATMIS) for the years 2023 and 2024. The support, limited to the police and civilian components of the missions, contributes to the gradual hand-over of security responsibility to the Somali authorities, in line with resolutions of the United Nations Security Council.
